prose: In this swapcast, Chance Garton of InnerVerse joins Sonja from The Tree of Knowledge for a luminous dialogue exploring the deep symbolic patterns at the root of our reality. Together, they follow the spiral path of inner knowing, unpacking the role of synchronicity, dreams, archetypal memory, and the awakening of divine consciousness. This episode is a weaving of mythic gnosis.
